races.paceDynamic: Three Socks On will take the early lead with no serious pressure from the prominent runners, creating a controlled tempo through the early stages. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Three Socks On can dictate fractions without being harried, while the six hold-up horses (Semper Femina, Houndswood Willow, Exquisite Skye, Virtue Chastity, Hove Ranger, Marveling) will be bunched behind waiting to pounce. This sets up a tactical finish where Three Socks On may have enough left to resist, but the sustainable pace will suit the patient hold-up brigade who can unleash late runs. The race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Three Socks On sets modest fractions and the field comes to him late
scenarios.body: The controlled pace allows the patient runners to close with telling effect in the final two furlongs. Hold-up specialists like Semper Femina and Exquisite Skye can unleash sustained finishes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Three Socks On gets away with soft sectionals and has enough left
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Three Socks On to bank energy for the finish and resist the late challenges. His recent wins at Salisbury show he can see out strong finishes.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improving Types Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the patient runners fail to quicken and fresher horses take advantage
scenarios.body: Horses returning from breaks like Virtue Chastity or Semper Femina could be primed for improvement. The steady pace suits those who need time to warm up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset from Bottom Weights
scenarios.trigger: If the handicapper has underestimated the improving three-year-olds at the foot of the weights
scenarios.body: Hove Ranger's recent Salisbury win and Marveling's consistent placing record could see them outrun their odds. The soft ground won't inconvenience either.

watchPoints.text: Three Socks On getting easy early fractions could allow him to dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back

Any early pace pressure on Three Socks On would completely change the complexion and favour the leaders

races.paceDynamic: Mr Freedom and Cruden will set a steady early gallop from the front with Selenic tracking close behind in third. The lack of natural speed horses means the pace will be genuine but not breakneck, allowing the early leaders to sustain their effort deep into the straight. With five hold-up horses likely bunched at the rear, they'll need the leaders to weaken significantly to mount effective challenges up the long Goodwood straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and early pace-setters who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Sustain
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Freedom and Cruden maintain their gallop to 2f out without cracking
scenarios.body: The modest pace allows the early leaders to kick again when the hold-up horses make their moves, proving too strong in the closing stages. The quintet of hold-up runners get in each other's way and can't generate enough momentum to reel in the principals.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses from 3f out and creates a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses find clear running simultaneously and their superior finishing kicks overwhelm the tiring pace-setters. Aggagio and Premiere Ligne benefit most from the strong finish with their proven stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Selenic gets the perfect stalking trip in fourth tracking the leaders
scenarios.body: The Prescott runner uses superior tactical speed from the ideal position to strike between horses when the pace quickens, avoiding the hold-up traffic while having enough left to pass the front two. This splits the difference between pace scenarios perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Completely Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If both Mr Freedom and Cruden go too hard early and fade dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete sprint finish from 4f out with the entire field converging together down the straight. The freshest hold-up horse with the best recent form gets up in a blanket finish that could go to any of six runners.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early pace between Mr Freedom and Cruden - if they go too fast early both will stop dramatically
Monitor Selenic's position through first half mile - if tracking closer than fourth she'll have perfect tactical setup
Observe how quickly the hold-up horses can organize themselves turning for home - traffic could eliminate half the field
Check if Aggagio gets boxed in behind the wall of hold-up horses - Queally needs to be wide early or have luck in running
Watch Mr Freedom's jumping from the stalls - any slow start ruins his front-running tactics completely

races.paceDynamic: Double Naughty will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, with Q T Pie likely to track in second early on. The soft ground at Goodwood's 6f will create a searching test of stamina, preventing any sprint finish and ensuring the pace becomes a true test throughout. With seven hold-up horses needing to make their moves from off the pace, this sets up perfectly for the prominent runners who can position close enough to strike when the leaders tire. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those who can sit handy rather than pure hold-up horses who will struggle to make up ground on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Double Naughty and Q T Pie control the tempo without going too fast early.
scenarios.body: The soft ground becomes a stamina test where those positioned within striking distance can pounce when the leaders weaken, while hold-up horses struggle to close from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong and the leaders stop quickly.
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect setup with a collapse in front, allowing the strongest stayers to sweep past in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Double Naughty gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady rhythm.
scenarios.body: The winner proves too strong for the field by dictating terms throughout, with the soft ground playing to stamina rather than pure speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos From Crowding
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates traffic problems turning for home.
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get hampered or blocked, allowing a horse with a clear run to capitalize on the confusion.

races.paceDynamic: Comic Strip will take this field along as the sole natural front-runner, setting an uncontested lead in this small field. With four hold-up horses (Wedonttelllies, Killavia, Saffron Dandy, Carefree Dream) all looking to come from off the pace, Comic Strip can dictate terms and control the gallop over this sharp 5f trip. The soft ground will emphasize stamina over pure speed, allowing Comic Strip to string out the field and make it difficult for the closers to reel him in. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runner who can control the pace and the hold-up horses with the best turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Comic Strip Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Comic Strip gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader can dictate a steady pace before quickening when it matters most on ground that will suit his stamina. Four hold-up horses leave him with a perfect tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs perfectly despite the tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: Wedonttelllies and Killavia have the class edge at the weights and superior recent form to overhaul Comic Strip in the final furlong. The soft ground could find out Comic Strip's stamina late on.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Comic Strip goes too slow early and gets swamped by multiple closers
scenarios.body: The four hold-up horses get the perfect scenario of a crawling pace before unleashing simultaneously in the final two furlongs. Saffron Dandy's better trip preferences could see him capitalize on the tactical shift.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Carefree Dream gets the perfect trip tracking the pace setters
scenarios.body: The bottom weight with recent course form could benefit from racing closer to the pace than usual given the tactical makeup. His 7lb claimer takes off crucial weight in a tight handicap.

races.paceDynamic: Desperate Dan will likely lead or sit prominent early, but with several other prominent runners (Eupator, Arctician, Post Rider, Warning Sign) there should be reasonable early pace. The soft going at Goodwood's 1m trip typically produces a steady gallop rather than breakneck speed, allowing the race to develop into a tactical affair. With three hold-up horses (Talis Evolvere, Zoffandia, Havana Blue) having scope to close, this pace setup should favour horses that can either dominate from the front or finish strongly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Desperate Dan gets an easy lead and the prominent runners fail to pressure him early
scenarios.body: The soft ground allows him to dictate fractions and kick clear when it matters. His recent Goodwood win in similar conditions shows he can handle the track when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest and the prominent runners engage each other
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks up Goodwood's demanding climb. Talis Evolvere and Zoffandia both have the class to capitalize on a strong pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Victory
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners successfully challenges Desperate Dan for the early lead
scenarios.body: The battle for position creates an honest pace that suits horses racing just behind the leaders. Eupator's recent second at Goodwood puts him in prime position to benefit from this tactical development.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Desperate Dan gets an uncontested lead and the field comes to him too late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the freshest horse wins, typically favouring those who haven't had a hard race. Warning Sign's extended break could prove advantageous if he's retained his ability.

The soft ground could favour horses with proven form on similar surfaces like Desperate Dan and Warning Sign
